name: Regulatory Reporting 10
definition: Information needed due to regulatory and/or statutory requirements.

DebitCreditReportingIndicator.name: Debit Credit Reporting Indicator
DebitCreditReportingIndicator.definition: Identifies whether the regulatory reporting information applies to the debit side, to the credit side or to both debit and credit sides of the transaction.

Authority.name: Authority
Authority.definition: Entity requiring the regulatory reporting information.

Details.name: Details
Details.definition: Set of elements used to provide details on the regulatory reporting information.
